name: pando
description: Pando: app interna de Wizor para seguir oportunidades comerciales, alianzas, fondeo y tareas.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace @pando/web
scripts.emulators: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @pando/functions && firebase emulators:start
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
